decl = ecommerce_information.get('supplementary_quantity_declaration_text', '')
import re
if not decl:

if not re.search(r'\b\d+\s*(?:N|number|U|unit|pc|piece|set|pair)\s*[xX]\s*\d+\s*(?:g|gram|kg|ml|L|m|cm)\b', decl):
    return 'POTENTIAL_NON_COMPLIANCE', 'Supplementary quantity declaration format must comply with standard multi-pack multiplication (e.g. 10 N x 10 g)'
return 'COMPLIANT', 'Supplementary multi-pack multiplication format is valid'
